profile.intended: dev opt-level=1, debug=0, incremental=false; dependency opt-level=2

protocol.callback: opaque false callback for cancellation; checks already present in each implementation are included
protocol.correctness_scope: Selected deterministic and adversarial cases, not a representative failure rate for user models or a complete correctness proof. Correctness compares the complete binary64 encoding; some old mismatches are one ULP while wide-exponent cancellation loses the whole residual.
protocol.kernel_scope: Actual arithmetic entry functions, including their existing validation/cancellation checks. Input/scratch allocation and copy excluded; legacy mutates scratch as its historical implementation did. Exact implementation included by path without source duplication.
protocol.limit_note: 16384 is the real MAX_ITEMS, so the largest workload reaches the supported per-list limit.
protocol.limitations: Single shared Linux virtual machine, no CPU pinning or isolation, turbo/frequency and concurrent system work uncontrolled. Same profile and data support local comparisons; absolute release/Windows speed and end-to-end graph latency are not established.
protocol.node_scope: Current math_nodes::run_list includes dispatch, Value-to-f64 conversion, cancellation, internal allocations and scalar output; historical adapter reproduces input handling plus old arithmetic but not the full match dispatch. Fixture Value creation excluded. No graph engine/cache/UI timings.
protocol.timer: std::time::Instant around a batch; divide duration by calls; report all samples and median/min/p90/max
